capabilities: link-profile-page | Publish a themed public profile containing links, managed through an authenticated administrator dashboard.
description:
LinkStack creates a public profile page collecting your links, with a private dashboard for managing links, appearance and themes. This recipe uses the upstream image with SQLite and completes its own setup forms before opening the public server, creating an administrator from enrollment parameters and disabling public registration. Application state is persisted separately from the image code in the linkstack folder of your home.

Enroll in base, choose the initial administrator email and page name, and save the generated password. Open the instance address, sign in at /login and add a link. Public visitors can read the profile and links; only signed-in accounts can edit them. Enrollment settings create the account only on a fresh database and do not reset it after restoration. See How to use this service for startup and storage limitations.

Customers pay the channel's platform compute base cost while the instance runs, including idle time. Labs adds no markup and receives no seller payout. This community recipe is unofficial; inclusion does not imply author endorsement or promised support.
